arxiv-2007-05293.title: Search for resonances decaying into a weak vector boson and a Higgs boson in the fully hadronic final state produced in proton–proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2007-05293.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2007-05293.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by The ATLAS Collaboration. A search for heavy resonances decaying into a W W or Z Z boson and a Higgs boson produced in proton–proton collisions at the Large Hadron Collider at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV is presented. The analysis utilizes the dominant W → q ​ q ¯ ′ W\to q\bar{q}^{\prime} or Z → q ​ q ¯ Z\to q\bar{q} and H → b ​ b ¯ H\to b\bar{b} decays with substructure techniques applied to large-radius jets.

arxiv-2011-09627.title: Connes distance of 2 ​ D 2D harmonic oscillators in quantum phase space
arxiv-2011-09627.creator: Bing-Sheng Lin, Tai-Hua Heng
arxiv-2011-09627.description: Abstract We study the Connes distance of quantum states of 2 ​ D 2D harmonic oscillators in phase space. Using the Hilbert-Schmidt operatorial formulation, we construct a boson Fock space and a quantum Hilbert space, and obtain the Dirac operator and a spectral triple corresponding to a 4 ​ D 4D quantum phase space.

arxiv-2112-04132.title: Sparse Representations of Solutions to a class of Random Boundary Value Problems Thanks: *Corresponding author.
arxiv-2112-04132.creator: Fang Yang, Min Chen, Jiecheng Chen, Ying Zhang, Tao Qian*
arxiv-2112-04132.description: Abstract . We introduce certain sparse representation methods, named as stochastic pre-orthogonal adaptive Fourier decomposition 1 and 2 (SPOAFD1 and SPOAFD2) to solve the Dirichlet boundary value problem and the Cauchy initial value problem of random data. To solve the stochastic boundary value problems the sparse representation is, as the initial step, applied to the random boundary data.

arxiv-2112-13165.title: Semantic Clustering based Deduction Learning for Image Recognition and Classification
arxiv-2112-13165.creator: Wenchi Ma, Xuemin Tu, Bo Luo, Guanghui Wang
arxiv-2112-13165.description: Abstract The paper proposes a semantic clustering based deduction learning by mimicking the learning and thinking process of human brains. Human beings can make judgments based on experience and cognition, and as a result, no one would recognize an unknown animal as a car.

arxiv-2203-10653.title: Oscillations of non-slender tori in the external Hartle-Thorne geometry
arxiv-2203-10653.creator: Monika Matuszková, 1,a Kateřina Klimovičová, 1,b \splitauthors Gabriela Urbancová, 1,c Debora Lančová, 1,d \splitauthors Eva Šrámková, []1 and Gabriel Török, []1 \ins 1Research Centre for Computational Physics and Data Processing, \splitins [1]Institute of Physics, Silesian University in Opava, Bezr
arxiv-2203-10653.description: Abstract We examine the influence of the quadrupole moment of a slowly rotating neutron star on the oscillations of non-slender accretion tori. We apply previously developed methods to perform analytical calculations of frequencies of the radial epicyclic mode of a torus in the specific case of the Hartle-Thorne geometry.

arxiv-2408-04341.title: On the Response of the Transition Region and the Corona to Rapid Excursions in the Chromosphere
arxiv-2408-04341.creator: Ravi Chaurasiya, A. Raja Bayanna, R. E. Louis, T.M.D. Pereira, S. K. Mathew
arxiv-2408-04341.description: Abstract Spicules are the thin hair/grass-like structures that are prominently observed at the chromospheric solar limb. It is believed that fibrils and rapid blueshifted and redshifted excursions (RBEs and RREs; collectively referred to as REs) correspond to on-disk counterparts of type I spicules and type II spicules, respectively.

pmc-11294611.title: MPE-YOLO: enhanced small target detection in aerial imaging
pmc-11294611.creator: Jia Su, Yichang Qin, Ze Jia, Ben Liang
pmc-11294611.description: Aerial image target detection is essential for urban planning, traffic monitoring, and disaster assessment. However, existing detection algorithms struggle with small target recognition and accuracy in complex environments. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved model based on YOLOv8, named MPE-YOLO.

pmc-12784838.title: Stage-Specific Alternative Polyadenylation During Human Neural Differentiation Revealed by Integrated Long- and Short-Read Sequencing
pmc-12784838.creator: Zheqi Lou, Xianyan Zeng, Tinghui Jiang, Peizhen Du, Jiyao Rao, Xinyan Dai, Haishuang Lin, Yong Zhu
pmc-12784838.description: Simple SummaryThe differentiation of pluripotent embryonic stem cells into specialized neural cells is a highly complex and precise process. Alternative polyadenylation (APA), a crucial post-transcriptional regulatory mechanism, plays a significant role in shaping gene expression. In this study, we integrated long- and short-read sequencing to profile the dynamic landscape of APA during early neural differentiation.

pmc-12827191.title: Links between facets of alexithymia, self-rated interoception, and social perception
pmc-12827191.creator: Lorna S. Jakobson, Pauline M. Pearson, Sarah N. Rigby
pmc-12827191.description: In three studies we examined relationships between facets of alexithymia, sensory processing sensitivity (SPS), interoception, and social perception. In Study 1 (N = 145), sensitivity to subtle cues (a positive SPS trait) negatively mediated the link between having an external focus (externally oriented thinking) and reporting low subjective interoceptive accuracy.

pmc-13133642.title: Elevated Plasma IL-18 Levels During Chemotherapy Treatment for Breast Cancer, Exercise Capacity, and Physical Activity
pmc-13133642.creator: Moriah P. Bellissimo, Matthew Ambrosio, Adolfo Gabriele Mauro, Eleonora Mezzaroma, Elisa N.D. Palladino, Bonnie Ky, Glenn J. Lesser, Ralph B. D’Agostino, Fadi N. Salloum, W. Gregory Hundley
pmc-13133642.description: Graphical Abstract Inflammatory cytokines, including interleukin (IL)–18, are implicated in the development of cardiovascular (CV) diseases for their roles in atherosclerotic plaque destabilization, cardiomyocyte hypertrophy, left ventricular (LV) myocardial contractile dysfunction, and fibrosis, all of which increase the risk for advanced stages of heart failure (HF).

pmc-13169946.title: Image-guided and surgical management of breast infections: Addressing diagnostic and therapeutic challenges
pmc-13169946.creator: Hina Pathan, Sana Zeeshan, Anam Khan
pmc-13169946.description: Background & Objectives:Inflammatory breast conditions encompass a broad spectrum, ranging from common acute lactational mastitis to rare chronic granulomatous diseases such as idiopathic granulomatous mastitis (IGM) and tuberculous mastitis (TBM). Chronic forms often mimic breast cancer, both clinically and radiologically, posing significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmc-13197954.title: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor/KIT-Linked Proliferative Bias in Normal Breast Lobules from Matched Non-Hispanic Black and White Women Is Rapidly Reversible by Receptor Tyrosine Kinase Inhibition
pmc-13197954.creator: Joshua W. Ogony, Nicole Cruz-Reyes, Laura Pacheco-Spann, Amanda Arnold, Sarah McLaughlin, Amy C. Degnim, Stacey J. Winham, Mark E. Sherman, Derek C. Radisky
pmc-13197954.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Basal-like/triple-negative breast cancers occur disproportionately at younger ages among non-Hispanic Black women (NHBW), but whether normal breast epithelium shows measurable, reversible differences in proliferative signaling is unclear. Histologically normal lobules from parity-, age-, and body mass index–matched NHBW and non-Hispanic White women (NHWW) donors (10 versus 10) were profiled using targeted transcriptomics (IO360/BC360) and whole-slide quantitative immunohistochemistry for epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), KIT, and cytokeratin-5.

pmc-13347711.title: Hydrogen Analysis by Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry
pmc-13347711.creator: Vladislav V. Lobodin, Yensil Park, Charles E. A. Finney
pmc-13347711.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The detection of hydrogen in complex gas mixtures is essential for many applications. Conventional approaches such as gas chromatography (GC) with thermal conductivity detection (TCD) and residual gas analyzers (RGAs) face significant limitations: TCD exhibits poor response when helium is used as a carrier gas, whereas RGAs lack chromatographic separation, preventing reliable quantification of hydrogen because of interference from other species.

pmc-13570337.title: Lysine-374 lactylation of TFRC is essential for TFRC-mediated kidney tubular ferroptosis in diabetic kidney disease
pmc-13570337.creator: Xiaomai Liu, Runzhu Yuan, Wenya Zhu, Jiaqing Xiang, Guangyan Yang, Lixing Li, Yanchun Li, Lin Kang, Shu Yang, Zhen Liang
pmc-13570337.description: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD), a leading cause of end-stage kidney disease, lactate overload and ferroptotic kidney injury, yet the mechanistic link between lactylation and ferroptosis remains undefined. Using lactylome profiling of db/db mouse kidneys, we identified transferrin receptor (TFRC) as the key ferroptosis regulator modified by lactylation. Here we explore the pathogenic role of TFRC lactylation in DKD progression.
